name: search_people_candidates
description: Return up to 10 basic indexed profiles matching all name terms plus optional company, location, and title filters. Requires people:search; legacy full-access keys with both people:enrich and agent:chat are accepted. Costs 1 ACU per completed search, including zero matches; failed searches are not charged. Never starts research or enrichment. Normal account billing, auto-recharge settings, and API-key spending caps apply. Send an Idempotency-Key to replay a request without another charge. Indexed identities and employment are unverified. Ask the user to choose before POST /v1/person, which costs 25 ACU unless the workspace already has active access. One bounded index request; no exhaustive count or pagination. Workspace limits: 30 requests/minute and 300/hour across keys. Active account eligibility still applies.

name: sync_people_search
description: Retrieve up to 150 people inline per request; async:true or a larger num_results starts a background People Set instead and returns 202 with set_id, items_url and events_url. instant returns indexed candidates as ranked by the index. fast compiles the query, reads a pool of at least 200 indexed candidates (three times num_results when that is larger) and ranks them by the stated role, place, employer, keywords, industry and seniority before returning the first num_results, without web verification. auto and deep research the complete query and explicit filters before returning matches with verification references; uncertain and rejected candidates are excluded from results, grounding and billing. Auto/deep compile the query, verify candidates, and run one bounded web recovery pass when too few match. Each verification pass permits up to 30 seconds for auto or 45 seconds for deep; recovery discovery permits 45 or 60 seconds respectively; the whole verification stage answers within 60 seconds for auto and 120 seconds for deep. A partial status means the requested count was not filled or verification hit its deadline; coverage.has_more says more candidates remained. Use Sets for durable research of large result sets. Verification is evidence-based model assessment, separate from identity verification. Requires people:search.

query.description: Optional semantic query. Supply this, at least one structured filter, or both.

type.description: instant returns indexed candidates; fast compiles the query and ranks a pool of at least 200 indexed candidates (three times num_results when larger) by it, without web verification. auto and deep require evidence-backed matches to the complete query and filters; deep also always runs public-web grounding. Verification may return fewer results within its deadline; Sets supports durable research for larger requests.

num_results.description: Up to 150 return inline. Larger requests run as a background People Set (self-serve up to 500).

criteria.description: Plain-English conditions every result must satisfy, such as 'Has founded a venture-backed company'. Each is researched and judged separately; results carry one verification entry per criterion and are ranked by evidence strength across all of them. Requires type auto or deep. In async searches they replace the criteria derived from the query.

async.description: Run as a background People Set and return 202 with set_id. Defaults to true above 150 results; false with a larger num_results is rejected. Async searches always verify each row, so type and contents do not apply.

webhook_url.description: Async searches only. Receives the Set's progress events.

filters.description: Hard filters, combined with AND, and enforced on every result. A row that contradicts one is dropped, and a row missing a filtered value is excluded. Each field takes one value, or { any_of, none_of }: any_of is OR, none_of drops a row whose stated value matches. title is a current-role match (word boundaries; a support role or an org name that only contains the word does not count). company is the current employer after legal-suffix normalization; Meta/Facebook, X/Twitter, and Google/Alphabet match. location must contain each place component, and short codes match whole tokens. seniority and industry match indexed fields only. company.employee_count, company.funding_stage, company_size, experience, and education are proven per person with cited evidence: they count toward the criteria limit and need type auto or deep or an async search. company_domain, radius_km, and tenure return 422 unsupported_filters and are never ignored. Each result's filter_match says how every filter was met.

name: create_dataset
description: Seed up to 25 rows (sync) or 2000 rows (async) of people, companies, or custom entities, and name up to 30 columns. Every cell is fused from many sources into one answer with a 0..1 confidence and public evidence URLs. Sync requests answer within deadline_ms (default 20000); cells still running at the deadline return status timeout. mode async returns 202 and fills rows in the background; poll GET /v1/datasets/{id} and page rows_url. Pay on hit: 1 ACU per 10 found standard cells (rounded up per request), 1 ACU per found custom cell, 1 ACU per work email, 3 ACU per personal email, 10 ACU per phone. not_found, unverified, and timeout cells are free. The API key reserves the all-found upper bound and releases the rest after the run. Requires people:search.

description: Filter Ploid's GitHub accounts index. Every criterion is AND; give at least one. Results come back by relevance when query or company is set, otherwise by merged pull requests and then commits; sort picks an activity ranking instead. Page with offset up to 1000 results deep; the last page before that shrinks to fit, so next_offset can always be followed with the same limit. With include_profiles, each account also carries its live public GitHub profile (limit defaults to and may not exceed 10). Costs 1 ACU per completed search plus 1 ACU per live profile found, charged together; failed searches are not charged. Emails and phone numbers are never returned. Requires people:search.

name: create_set
description: Create a preview People Set and start a durable criteria-verified search. Requires people:search.

criteria.description: Conditions every admitted person must satisfy; omitted criteria are derived from the query.

filters.description: Hard filters, combined with AND, and enforced on every result. A row that contradicts one is dropped, and a row missing a filtered value is excluded. Each field takes one value, or { any_of, none_of }: any_of is OR, none_of drops a row whose stated value matches. title is a current-role match (word boundaries; a support role or an org name that only contains the word does not count). company is the current employer after legal-suffix normalization; Meta/Facebook, X/Twitter, and Google/Alphabet match. location must contain each place component, and short codes match whole tokens. seniority and industry match indexed fields only. company.employee_count, company.funding_stage, company_size, experience, and education are proven per person with cited evidence: they count toward the criteria limit and need type auto or deep or an async search. company_domain, radius_km, and tenure return 422 unsupported_filters and are never ignored. Each result's filter_match says how every filter was met.

title.description: Current job title must hold this role, or one of any_of.

any_of.description: Matches when the field holds any of these values.

none_of.description: Drops a row whose stated value matches any of these; a missing value is not an exclusion.

seniority.description: Indexed seniority or title must match. Recognized levels: entry, junior, mid, senior, staff, principal, director, vp, cxo.

any_of.description: Matches when the field holds any of these values.

none_of.description: Drops a row whose stated value matches any of these; a missing value is not an exclusion.

company.description: Current employer name. Legal suffixes are ignored; a longer or different name does not match.

any_of.description: Matches when the field holds any of these values.

none_of.description: Drops a row whose stated value matches any of these; a missing value is not an exclusion.

employee_count.description: Current employer headcount, verified with evidence.

funding_stage.description: Current employer's latest funding stage, verified with evidence.

industry.description: Indexed industry must contain this value. Results without an indexed industry cannot satisfy it.

any_of.description: Matches when the field holds any of these values.

none_of.description: Drops a row whose stated value matches any of these; a missing value is not an exclusion.

location.description: City, state, or country must contain this place. State names and postal abbreviations match.

any_of.description: Matches when the field holds any of these values.

none_of.description: Drops a row whose stated value matches any of these; a missing value is not an exclusion.

countries.description: Joined with cities and any_of as alternatives.

cities.description: Joined with countries and any_of as alternatives.

company_size.description: Current employer headcount, verified with evidence. Same as company.employee_count.

experience.description: A past role (not only the current one) at one of these companies, verified with evidence.

education.description: Attended one of these schools, verified with evidence.

freshness.description: How recently the facts behind each result must have been confirmed. max_age_days caps the age of cached evidence for every candidate: 0 means always re-read live sources. Omitted, verification picks a window per request from the time-sensitive facts it depends on (current role, location) and refreshes only the top-ranked candidates. Requires verification: type auto or deep, or an async search; instant and fast return 422 unsupported_freshness. Tighter windows cost more live reads and can return fewer results within the deadline. The response echoes the applied window under request.freshness.

max_age_days.description: Maximum age, in days, of the cached evidence behind each returned result.

credits.description: Maximum credits for all searches in this Set.

llm_tokens.description: Compatibility value currently ignored by Ploid.

name: start_dataset
description: Start an asynchronous dataset to fill up to 2000 rows with sourced column values. Requires people:search.

mode.description: Asynchronous mode; automatically supplied when omitted.

items.description: Identifies one row's subject. At least one of name, domain, linkedin_url, email, or a socials value is required.

linkedin_url.description: A LinkedIn person (/in/) or company (/company/) URL.

socials.description: Handles or profile URLs per platform, plus the subject's own website.

rows.description: At most 25 rows for sync requests.

key.description: A built-in field for the entity type, or custom.<name> (1-60 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores).

description.description: Required for custom.* columns: what to find.

format.description: custom.* only; defaults to text. Built-in fields have a fixed format.

deadline_ms.description: Sync only: cells not filled by then return status timeout. Ignored for async.

freshness.description: Oldest cached evidence reused without a live read; 0 re-reads everything. Omitted, each field uses its own window.

include_unverified.description: Also return the best value of unverified cells, with its confidence and evidence. They keep status unverified and are not billed; confidence folds in how likely the profile is the row's subject.

idempotencyKey.description: Recommended on non-streaming POSTs. Reusing the same key and authenticated request within 24 hours replays the original response and bills once. Live SSE responses reject this header; use a durable async run for replayable work.

seed.description: Identifies one row's subject. At least one of name, domain, linkedin_url, email, or a socials value is required.

linkedin_url.description: A LinkedIn person (/in/) or company (/company/) URL.

socials.description: Handles or profile URLs per platform, plus the subject's own website.

cells.description: One cell per requested column key.

max_credits.description: Upper bound if every requested cell were found; reserved against the API key budget.
